description.value: Pemberton Bike Co. is Whistler's original independent, locally owned bike and ski shop, operating since 1994 under the legal name Whistler Bike Co. Inc. DBA Pemberton Bike Co. The shop stocks major brands (Kona, Norco, Giant, Liv, Devinci) alongside a wide range of parts and accessories, and runs a full mechanical service department covering everything from enduro rigs to e-bike commuters. Touring cyclists will find this a solid stop in the Sea-to-Sky corridor for repairs, rentals, and consumables.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (12 spaces) at 11m. Total: 12 spaces.
